durableFields.notes: Existing battle turn-resource field owns whether the current actor still has a Bonus Action available. Adrenaline Rush spends this field through the public battle reducer route.
Existing battle turn-resource field owns feature-resource spends for battle-time Unit feature activations, including the Adrenaline Rush use spent by the Bonus Action Dash.
Existing battle turn-resource field owns accumulated Dash bonus Movement. Adrenaline Rush supplies Speed from the unit/creature facts and stores only the resulting battle movement budget.
Existing combatant field owns Temporary Hit Points. Adrenaline Rush replaces the value only when its Proficiency Bonus grant is higher, matching the non-stacking Temporary Hit Points rule.

Existing character-origin unit references supply the feature payload, Speed-derived Dash subject, and Proficiency Bonus-based Temporary Hit Points amount. Task 2 adds no duplicate Speed or Proficiency Bonus state to BattleState.

notes: Task 2 introduced no new durable BattleState or BattleCreatureState fields.
